name: Mutou Reika
source: A girl Masaki met through the 'Incest Dating Club'. She's in love with her own father and joins the club to try and forget about him. She tells Masaki that he reminds her of her father. Although she looks a lot like his daughter Yuriko she has a very different personality, often aloof and sometimes cold. She tells Masaki that she has just turned 18 so she can do adult things.
